reference_model.purpose: Describe reusable question architectures inspired by common free math worksheet patterns and teacher-supplied examples without copying source questions or layouts verbatim.
source_principles: Kuta-style fluency: narrow skill focus, many parameterized variations, clean printable density, straightforward progression.
DeltaMath-style conceptual structure: diagrams, multiple representations, scaffolded multi-part reasoning, contextual application, tables, grids, and double number lines.
Teacher-owned output standard: original questions, two-column print by default, accurate MathJax, deterministic visuals, adjustable workspace and graph/diagram scale.
reference_model.copyright_rule: Use source materials only to infer structure, representation, pacing, and difficulty. Do not reproduce source wording, names, numbers, diagrams, or answer choices.

families.label: Equivalent Ratio / Multiplicative Comparison
families.summary: Move between two quantities with a multiplicative factor and express the factor as a whole number or simplified fraction.

families.label: Simplify Ratios
families.summary: Simplify part-to-part or part-to-whole ratios from numeric quantities.

families.label: Unit Rate / Scale to One
families.summary: Use division to move to a unit rate or one-unit benchmark, then scale to a target value.

families.label: Scaled Figures — Find Scale Factor
families.summary: Compare two original geometric figures with labeled side lengths and determine the scale factor.

families.label: Scaled / Rotated Figures — Corresponding Side
families.summary: Identify corresponding sides between scaled figures that may be translated or rotated, then reason about scale factor.

families.label: Dilation on a Coordinate Grid
families.summary: Plot or complete a dilation when a scale factor and part of the image/preimage are supplied.

families.label: Ratio from a Shape Diagram
families.summary: Count categories of repeated shapes, write an unsimplified ratio, then simplify or interpret the ratio.

families.label: Double Number Line
families.summary: Represent two proportional quantities on aligned number lines and solve for a missing value.

families.label: Ratio Table — Complete or Choose
families.summary: Complete a proportional ratio table or identify which table preserves the given ratio.

families.label: Multi-Row Proportional Table
families.summary: Use a recipe or mixture table with several related quantities, including fractional values, to complete missing entries.

families.label: Compare Mixtures / Concentrations
families.summary: Compare two mixtures or recipes by reasoning about ratios, concentration, or unit rates.

families.label: Scale Drawing — Actual Measure
families.summary: Use a stated drawing scale to determine an actual length, perimeter, area, or travel distance.

families.label: Recipe / Batch Scaling
families.summary: Scale a recipe or batch from a known serving amount to a new amount and solve for one or more ingredients.

families.label: Part-to-Part / Part-to-Whole / Multi-Part Ratio
families.summary: Write and interpret multiple ratios from the same context, including part-to-whole fractions or multi-part ratios.

families.label: Error Analysis / Explain the Ratio Reasoning
families.summary: Diagnose a plausible ratio, scale-factor, or proportional-reasoning error and correct it.

generic_families.label: Direct Skill Practice
generic_families.summary: Short, parameterized practice focused on one procedure or fact pattern.

generic_families.label: Multiple Representation
generic_families.summary: Ask students to connect two representations such as equation/table/graph/diagram/context.

generic_families.label: Diagram / Graph / Model
generic_families.summary: Use a quantitatively accurate visual as part of the evidence.

generic_families.label: Error Analysis
generic_families.summary: Diagnose and correct a plausible student error.

generic_families.label: Context / Transfer
generic_families.summary: Apply the selected skill in a concise original context.

generic_families.label: Multi-Part Scaffold
generic_families.summary: Sequence a small set of linked prompts that build toward a final response.
